items.title: NYC lawmakers weigh compromise on Amazon delivery worker bill, Bloomberg reports
items.summary: Investing.com -- New York City lawmakers are weighing substantial revisions to proposed legislation that would force Amazon.com Inc (NASDAQ:AMZN) to directly employ thousands of outsourced delivery drivers, according to a Bloomberg report. The potential overhaul signals a strategic compromise in a high-stakes regulatory battle pitting the e-commerce giant against Mayor Zohran Mamdani and a City Council majority.

items.title: NYC Lawmakers Weigh Overhaul of Amazon Delivery Worker Bill
items.summary: New York City lawmakers are in discussions to modify a mandate that would require Amazon.com Inc. to directly hire thousands of delivery workers under a bill that has pitted the company against Mayor Zohran Mamdani.
